keywords.nuance: せいぜい sets a boundary or realistic upper limit. It can also be used to imply a mild complaint: 'if anything, at minimum.'
keywords.example: せいぜい十分休んでください。
keywords.exampleTranslation: Take at least a decent amount of rest, at any rate.

commonPitfall.title: Common Pitfall
commonPitfall.body: せいぜい is often misunderstood as only negative. It can be gentle suggestion ('at least do this') as well as a limit ('no more than this').

questions.prompt: せいぜい明日の朝まで待って。
questions.answer: At the latest, wait until tomorrow morning.

questions.prompt: せいぜいのことは助けるよ。
questions.hint: At least we can do something.
questions.answer: I can help as much as I can.

questions.prompt: せいぜいこれくらいで十分でしょう。
questions.answer: This much should be enough, at least.

productionQuestions.prompt: At most, stay for one hour.
productionQuestions.hint: Limit the amount of time with せいぜい.

referenceAnswers.answer: せいぜい1時間だけいて。
せいぜい一時間くらいで大丈夫です。
referenceAnswers.note: More polite and softens the limit.

productionQuestions.prompt: At best, I can review two pages.
productionQuestions.hint: Use せいぜい to express realistic minimum support.

referenceAnswers.answer: せいぜい2ページしか見直せます。
referenceAnswers.note: Directly expresses 'only this much is possible.'

referenceAnswers.answer: せいぜい二ページまでしか復習できる。
referenceAnswers.note: Uses explicit scope with までまで.

productionQuestions.prompt: Do at least this much; more is impossible anyway.
productionQuestions.hint: Use せいぜい as best-effort framing.

referenceAnswers.answer: せいぜいこれだけでいい、それ以上は難しい。
referenceAnswers.note: Very natural when setting practical limits.

referenceAnswers.answer: せいぜいこのくらいまでが限界です。
referenceAnswers.note: More structured phrasing with 限界.

productionQuestions.prompt: At most, he could only stay five minutes.
productionQuestions.hint: Quantify the maximum with せいぜい.

referenceAnswers.answer: せいぜい5分しか滞在できなかった。
せいぜい、彼は5分程度しかいられなかった。
